titles.head: The 男坂
titles.text: Fifty-two stone steps between red handrails: the stairs at the end of Your Name, ten years old this year.

titles.head: Docomo Tower over the garden
titles.text: 240 m of offices and antennas since 2000, over a garden that was the Imperial family's until 1949.

titles.head: Kabukicho Ichibangai
titles.text: The red arch has lit the way in since 1969, to a kabuki theatre that was never built.
